groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.685% and the 10Y at 4.908%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -1.62% over five sessions and -3.62% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +1.72% at about $90.91, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-40/100, 68% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, supportive options positioning on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
